beaches.name: Hawk Cliff (Vico / White Rock)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers share the Vico bathing place at Hawk Cliff. The Irish Naturist Association lists the changing-hut and diving-board area as shared by naturists and textile bathers, and a small cove to the south as also used by naturists. It records that in 2017 Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council agreed to erect signs about nude bathers but later withdrew from the agreement; there is no official designation or signage.
